svg.title: Calling an external system through a connector
svg.desc: 1. An admin turns on a connector and chooses which roles may use it. 2. Credentials are stored for the company, never shown back in logs. 3. When the agent calls the connector, the outbound request is checked against the resolved IP address and private ranges are blocked. 4. The call is written to the connector audit table. 5. A scheduled re-test notifies admins only when a working connector starts failing.
